purpose: Reconstruct the decision-function-probe A baseline with one authorized outer fit per participant-disjoint fold, verify model loadability, reproduce the saved 7.5 s A score array by stable window ID, and create a new event replay reference without running 3 s inference.

source_of_truth.target_lineage: decision-function-probe A; the model-review artifact is not the target because it has no raw score array or event-prediction artifact

target_scores.lineage_binding: The frozen probe implementation writes global_scores[A] in the exact feature-table row order. The NPZ itself has no embedded IDs; this reconstruction binds the target array to feature-table row_keys through that hashed implementation and verifies alignment by row_key maps, not by an unverified arbitrary array position.

historical_model_review.use: lineage comparison only; not mixed with target scores, thresholds, or event outcomes

target_selection.selection_reason: It is the only lineage with a frozen A definition, frozen feature table, participant-disjoint outer mapping, raw 632100-row A score array, and fold-specific q/threshold records in one report.
not_targeted: historical 207/234 event result as a reproduction target
target_selection.event_reference_status: The target decision-function probe explicitly recorded event_level_replay=NOT_RUN_WINDOW_EFFECT_NOT_REPRODUCED. Any event replay in this reconstruction is a newly established diagnostic reference, not a reproduction of 207/234.

authorization_and_circuit_breaker.authorized_fit: A only; exactly one outer fit per outer fold
authorization_and_circuit_breaker.inner_fit_reason: All five selected q values and final numeric thresholds are present in the target report; no inner search is rerun.

dataset_and_stable_window_ids.alignment_rule: Build target and reconstructed score maps keyed by row_keys; compare only matching unique IDs. Report missing/extra/duplicate IDs before any numeric comparison.

participant_disjoint_outer_protocol.fit_rule: train only on the complementary participant set; score each validation participant with that fold model; no participant leakage

labels_and_weights.unsupervised: label == -1; excluded from fit and scoring

estimator.preprocessing: raw finite imu_stats_v1; no scaler, feature selection, or fitted transform

threshold_reconstruction.future_A_B_rule: Use the same numeric threshold for the same fold; do not recompute it on 3 s data.

eventizer.approved_skip_rule: preserve existing eligibility/processed-record contract; do not fabricate skipped recordings

environment.verification_rule: record actual runtime versions in the report and reject loadability if saved estimator cannot be loaded in this environment

comparison_tolerances.reason: The target and reconstruction use the same frozen feature bytes, estimator parameters, seed, and runtime contract; a near-machine-precision tolerance tests identity rather than AUROC similarity.
comparison_tolerances.selected_state_comparison: exact boolean equality of score >= saved threshold
comparison_tolerances.window_id_comparison: exact string equality after unique row_key validation

resource_budget.retry_policy: no retry, seed change, parameter change, or outer-result-driven refit
